subject: BLUEPRINT VERDICT (flash): Inverted CRPS gate, Shin direction reversal, and latency-arbitrage category error
body:
My independent adversarial audit of sports/research/2026-09-18-tracking-decoupled-blueprint.txt is complete. Full report written to sports/research/2026-09-18-blueprint-verdict-flash.md.

Key Findings & Inversions Audited:
1. INVERTED CRPS GATE: Line 39 requires 'CRPS improvement of LESS THAN 0.01', contradicting Line 138 ('demonstrably beat'). CRPS is a loss (lower is better); requiring improvement < 0.01 means graduating when improvement is negligible. Correct threshold: Delta CRPS >= 0.01 on N>=150 settled spreads.
2. SHIN DEVIG DIRECTION & PROVEN STREAK HAZARD: The text claims proportional overweights favourites and Shin shades back to 0.5. False: proportional UNDER-removes vig from longshots; Shin increases favourite probability (moves AWAY from midpoint). Switching to Shin would restart our live PROVEN streak and shrink perceived edge on heavy MLB favourites. Founder-gated only.
3. LATENCY ARBITRAGE CATEGORY ERROR: Exploiting 200-400ms bookmaker repricing lag is a biological constant (cornerback hip-flip) transplanted into an advisory subscription platform running on a 6-hour cron. Retail books have delay spinners, limits, and voids. KILLED.
4. UNMEASURED 5% CORRUPTION GUESS: The 5% market data failure rate originated as an unverified guess and was laundered into a requirement. We must measure the empirical rate first; kill if < 1.0%.
5. VALID CONTRIBUTIONS TO ADOPT: Closed-form Gaussian CRPS, RTS-smoothed B-spline curvature, Jackknife+ 1-2alpha (80% at alpha=0.10), and Venn-Abers [p0, p1] epistemic width gating with robust Kelly sizing.
